name: The Green Labyrinth
description:
Iona marks a jungle temple where the stones seem to remember footsteps.

Search jungle temple loot. Watch the traps while exploring. Earn End Remastered's rogue eye advancement by obtaining the eye. This record keeps working after you use the eye. Eyes are never consumed by this quest. Loot can be random; choose other routes for the portal if a source proves elusive.
